"""S410-S416 static check for round r6b2 (SPEC_LOGIC_R6B.md D625-D627, D651, D653 part 2).
State, ViewModel and UndoCoordinator. Stdlib only; textual contract only."""
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MAIN = ROOT / "app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative"
results = []
BANNED = ["DeleteMedicationCommand", "DeleteLabInvestigationCommand", "RestoreMedicationCommand", "RestoreLabInvestigationCommand",
          "DeletionKind", "RequestDeleteMedication", "RequestDeleteLab"]
OLD_UNDO = ["UndoKind", "DELETE_MED", "DELETE_LAB", "SAVE_MED"]
ALLOWED_UI = {"MedicationEditor.kt", "LabEditor.kt", "WorkspaceScreen.kt"}


def record(name, ok, detail=""):
    results.append(ok)
    print(("PASS" if ok else "FAIL") + " " + name + (": " + detail if detail and not ok else ""))


def read(path):
    try:
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except OSError:
        return ""


def missing(src, names):
    return [n for n in names if n not in src]


def main_files():
    return sorted(MAIN.rglob("*.kt"))


def main():
    hits = []
    for f in main_files():
        src = read(f)
        for n in BANNED:
            if re.search(r"\b" + n + r"\b", src):
                hits.append(f.name + ":" + n)
    record("S410 no per-kind command, DeletionKind or per-kind Request event identifier left in app/src/main", not hits, ", ".join(hits))

    state = read(MAIN / "state/AncState.kt")
    vm = read(MAIN / "state/AncViewModel.kt")
    old = [n for n in OLD_UNDO if re.search(r"\b" + n + r"\b", state + vm)]
    miss = missing(state, ["class RequestDelete", "class PendingDeletion", "class UndoOffer", "DeletableType"])
    record("S411 AncState: generic RequestDelete, PendingDeletion and UndoOffer keyed by DeletableType; old UndoKind gone",
           not miss and not old, "missing " + ", ".join(miss) + ("; old " + ", ".join(old) if old else ""))

    problems = []
    for f in (MAIN / "state/AncViewModel.kt", MAIN / "state/AncState.kt", MAIN / "state/UndoCoordinator.kt"):
        src = read(f)
        if re.search(r"\bwhen\s*\([^)]*(type|kind)[^)]*\)", src, re.I) and re.search(r"DeletableType\.[A-Z_]+\s*->", src):
            problems.append(f.name + " branches on DeletableType")
        if re.search(r"DeletableType\.[A-Z_]+\s*->|[!=]=\s*DeletableType\.|\bis\s+DeletableType\b", src):
            problems.append(f.name + " has a DeletableType branch")
    record("S412 no DeletableType branch in AncViewModel, AncState or UndoCoordinator", not problems, "; ".join(sorted(set(problems))))

    co = read(MAIN / "state/UndoCoordinator.kt")
    miss = missing(co, ["class UndoCoordinator", "fun beginDelete", "fun offerSaveUndo", "fun request", "fun clear", "MAX_UNDO_RESTARTS", "CoroutineScope"])
    android = [p for p in ("import android.", "androidx.lifecycle", "viewModelScope", "androidx.compose") if p in co]
    record("S413 UndoCoordinator: plain class with the four public entry points, injectable scope, no Android types",
           bool(co) and not miss and not android, "missing " + ", ".join(miss) + ("; android: " + ", ".join(android) if android else ""))

    eh = read(MAIN / "state/EditorHooks.kt")
    miss = missing(eh, ["interface EditorHook", "isOpenFor", "closeEditor", "rebaseCreateDraft"])
    record("S414 EditorHooks.kt: EditorHook with isOpenFor, closeEditor, rebaseCreateDraft", not miss, "missing " + ", ".join(miss))

    left = [n for n in ("armUndo", "startUndoExpiry", "PendingUndo") if re.search(r"\b" + n + r"\b", vm)]
    n8 = sum(len(re.findall(r"(?<![-\w\"])8_?000L?(?![-\w\"])", read(f))) for f in (MAIN / "state").rglob("*.kt"))
    record("S415 timer owned once by the coordinator: the 8000 ms literal appears exactly once under state/, VM has no armUndo/startUndoExpiry/PendingUndo",
           n8 == 1 and re.search(r"\b8_?000L?\b", co) is not None and not left and "UndoCoordinator" in vm, "8000 count=%d; left in VM: %s; VM uses UndoCoordinator=%s" % (n8, left, "UndoCoordinator" in vm))

    repo = read(MAIN / "storage/RecordsRepository.kt")
    n_del = len(re.findall(r"\bfun\s+deleteRecord\s*\(", repo))
    n_res = len(re.findall(r"\bfun\s+restoreRecord\s*\(", repo))
    problems = []
    if n_del != 1 or n_res != 1:
        problems.append("deleteRecord=%d restoreRecord=%d" % (n_del, n_res))
    try:
        for line in subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.splitlines():
            if re.search(r"app/schemas/|RecordsMigration|RecordsDatabase\.kt|RecordsDao\.kt", line):
                problems.append("forbidden file changed: " + line)
            m = re.search(r"/ancnative/ui/([^/]+)$", line)
            if m and m.group(1) not in ALLOWED_UI:
                problems.append("ui file outside allow list: " + line)
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as exc:
        problems.append("git diff failed: " + str(exc))
    db = read(MAIN / "storage/RecordsDatabase.kt")
    record("S416 repository keeps one deleteRecord/restoreRecord; no schema, version, DAO or stray ui change",
           not problems and bool(re.search(r"version\s*=\s*6\b", db)), "; ".join(problems) or "version != 6")
    sys.exit(0 if all(results) else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Owning-patient check is not in the adapter: the repository compares `record.patientId` to the command once (generic).
D622 Registry. `object DeletableRegistry { fun <T> of(type): DeletableRecordAdapter<T> }` backed by a `Map<DeletableType, adapter>` built from a single list in one file; adding a kind = new adapter file + one list entry + one enum value. A unit test asserts every enum value is registered and every `fingerprintTag` and receipt kind is unique.
D623 Generic commands. `DeleteRecordCommand(type, editorSessionId="", operationUuid, patientId, expectedPatientRevision, recordId, expectedRecordRevision, deletedContentHash)` and `RestoreRecordCommand(type, operationUuid, patientId, expectedPatientRevision, record: DeletableRecord, sourceDelete: DeleteRecordCommand)`, both implementing `sealed interface RecordUndoCommand : ClinicalCommand { fun withPatientRevision(rev: Long): RecordUndoCommand }` (replaces the `when` at VM `:1176`). `recordKind` stays `ClinicalRecordKind`: the four existing values are kept; a new kind adds two enum values (the enum is a stored string, no DB constraint). Validity, fingerprint and `destination()/savedNotice()` come from the adapter: fingerprint is `"{tag}_DEL|op|pid|pRev|recordId|recordRev|hash"` and `"{tag}_RES|op|pid|pRev|" + sourceDelete.fingerprint + "|" + canonical(record)`, identical to D601/D602 text so receipts written by build 19c36fc still replay.
D624 Repository: ONE `deleteRecord(cmd)` and ONE `restoreRecord(cmd)` replace the four branches; both fetch the adapter from the registry and use only adapter methods plus the existing DAO queries and `deleteRestoreGuardFailure`. All D605/D606 rules, error codes, rollback-by-`ClinicalCommandAbort` and the D613 comment stay verbatim, in one place. `ClinicalDeleteRule.evaluateRestore(receipt, latest, existingRow, cmd)` loses its `when` (uses `cmd.type`, adapter tag and `contentHash`); its signature is unchanged, so `ClinicalDeleteRuleTest` keeps its call shape.
D625 State. `PendingDeletion(patientId, type, recordId)`; `UndoOffer(token, patientId, type, action: DELETE|SAVE, label, phase)` (these were already generic in shape; only the enums change; still no clinical payload beyond the label). Events collapse to `RequestDelete(patientId, type, recordId)` (replaces the two Request events); Cancel/Confirm/Committed/Failed/Undo* are unchanged. Editor-specific reducer code moves behind `EditorHook` (state package): `isOpenFor(state, recordId)`, `closeEditor(state, patientId): AncState`, `rebaseCreateDraft(state, patients): AncState`. Medication and lab hooks wrap today's `medicationDraft`/`labDraft` code (`AncState.kt:877-891`, `:910-927`); the reducer calls the hook through the registry, so no `if (kind == ...)` remains. The `SavedNotice` aliases (`:208-214`) are replaced by `adapter.deletedNotice` etc.
D626 `UndoCoordinator` (new `state/UndoCoordinator.kt`, plain class, no Android types) owns everything the ViewModel does now for Undo: `pending` token/command, 8000 ms timer (injectable `CoroutineScope` so tests use virtual time), restart-once (`MAX_UNDO_RESTARTS`), ambiguous replay of the exact command, STALE_PATIENT_REVISION retry after a fresh snapshot, stale-token no-op, newer offer replaces and finalises the older, lock/epoch clear and `sessionStillCurrent` check. Public surface: `beginDelete(type, patientId, recordId)`, `offerSaveUndo(type, patientId, recordId, receipt, savedRecord)`, `request(token)`, `clear()`. It talks to the outside through three lambdas only: `execute(cmd, epoch)`, `dispatch(AncEvent)`, `currentState()`. The ViewModel keeps one field and four delegating lines (`confirmDelete`, `requestUndo`, the post-save hook, `clearFrozenCommands`). `confirmDelete`'s two branches become one: find record via `adapter.record(...)`, build `DeleteRecordCommand` and the matching `RestoreRecordCommand`, run, arm the offer.
D627 Behaviour is frozen: every D610-D613 rule (dirty/archived/saving ignored, ConfirmDelete closes clean editor on same record, undo rebase, SubmitMedication* ignored while RUNNING, session epoch clear, 8 s then gone, one restart) is preserved bit for bit. Only the mechanism moves. No Room entity, DAO query signature, schema JSON or DB version changes (`app/schemas` untouched, S303 style check stays).
D628 Kinds that fit the adapter as is: medication, lab, ultrasound scan (has `revision`, table `ultrasound_scans`), previous pregnancy (`previous_pregnancies`), visit (`visits`), dating is NOT deletable (one row per patient, edit only). Delivery plan is added when its table/record exists (it needs a revision column; if it is a single row per patient it is edit-only like dating). Attachments are different (see D629).
D629 Attachments (`patient_attachments`, file on disk, no revision, deleted today by `VaultController.deleteAttachment` `:477`): need a two-phase adapter. Extra optional adapter members `val hasPayloadFile` + `suspend fun finalizeDelete(record)`: the row and receipt delete immediately, the encrypted file is shredded only when the Undo window closes (UndoExpired, second failure, replacement by a newer offer, or lock), and Restore is refused with RECORD_CONFLICT after finalize. This goes in its own later round and needs its own spec section because a lock must finalize (shred) rather than just forget. Until then attachments keep today's path.
D630 Hard rules for adapters: label shows the record name only (medication name, test name, scan date, pregnancy year); an adapter must not log or persist clinical text; the hash must cover every user-editable field and exclude `revision`; `canonical` order matches the kind's save fingerprint so a field added later fails the hash test.

D654 Isolation and database integrity: a delete or restore of one record must never change (a) any row of another section/kind, even one with an identical record id string, (b) any row or revision of another patient, (c) another record's revision, nor violate database rules. Required oracles (test lane, per kind, in `androidTest/.../ClinicalDeleteRestoreDbTest.kt`; the existing 23 methods stay unchanged, NEW test methods are allowed): a snapshot-diff test that dumps every table (medications, lab investigations, patients, attachments, receipts, all other record tables) before and after delete, restore, and failed attempts (stale revision, wrong hash, wrong patient, archived) and asserts the ONLY differences are the target row, that patient's revision and the new receipt (none for failed attempts); cross-kind id collision (same recordId string in medication and lab: deleting or restoring one leaves the other untouched); two patients with same-looking records (other patient's rows and revision untouched); `PRAGMA foreign_key_check` returns no rows and `PRAGMA integrity_check` returns `ok` after every operation; no cascade side effects; restore never re-inserts into the wrong table or for the wrong patient. Applies to r6b1 (storage) and, through the same DB test, to every later adapter round and to r6b2 (the coordinator must only ever hand the confirmed command to execute).

## 3. Shared UI pieces (for the later UI round; none built in logic rounds)
D640 `DeleteConfirmDialog(pending: PendingDeletion, label: String, onCancel, onConfirm)` in `ui/Components.kt` (or new `ui/DeleteUi.kt`): one dialog, text from two shared strings (title with the type name, body "This permanently deletes ... You can undo for 8 seconds."), destructive confirm button, hosted once in `AncApp.kt` from `state.deleteConfirmation`. Sections never render their own dialog.
D641 `UndoBarHost(offer: UndoOffer?, onUndo(token))` one instance at app level in `AncApp.kt` (above the navigation bar, under system insets), shows `label`, an Undo button (disabled and "Restoring" while phase RUNNING), uses an `AnimatedVisibility`; sections never show their own bar. Announces via `liveRegion` for accessibility.
D642 `DeleteIconButton(contentDescription, onClick)`: trash icon in a `minimumTouchTarget()` (`Components.kt:150`, 48 dp), error-tinted, used identically on every row; callers pass only `onClick = { dispatch(AncEvent.RequestDelete(pid, type, id)) }`.
D643 Strings once in `res/values/strings.xml`: `delete_confirm_title_{type}` (one per type, short noun), `delete_confirm_body`, `delete_confirm_action`, `undo_action`, `undo_restoring`, `undo_bar_deleted` ("%1$s deleted"), `undo_bar_saved` ("%1$s saved"). Type noun comes from a `DeletableType -> @StringRes` function (one `when`, in one place). No string per section for the body or the bar.
D644 Existing screens (MedicationEditor/LabEditor/WorkspaceScreen) only add `DeleteIconButton`; the 8 s window, dialog and bar are not touched per section.

## 4. Migration plan (keeps the suite green)
D650 Order: tests first (independent author), then core, then ui. Each round ends with the full unit gate + `ClinicalDeleteRestoreDbTest` on the emulator.
D651 Source compatibility trick: during R6b-1 keep `DeleteMedicationCommand(...)` etc. as top-level factory functions returning `DeleteRecordCommand(type = MEDICATION, ...)` so callers compile; remove them at the end of R6b-2 once the ViewModel and tests use the generic names.
D652 Tests that move (assertions stay):
- `test/.../storage/ClinicalCommandsTest.kt` (24 tests, 4 touch delete/restore): the med/lab command cases fold into one parameterised `DeleteRestoreCommandTest` over `DeletableRegistry.all()`; the two content-hash tests stay per adapter (`MedicationAdapterTest`, `LabAdapterTest`). Fingerprint literals ("MED_DEL|...") are kept as golden strings to prove byte-identical output.
- `test/.../storage/ClinicalDeleteRuleTest.kt` (9 tests): same signature, constructs generic commands.
- `test/.../state/AncDeleteUndoStateTest.kt`: `RequestDeleteMedication/Lab` become `RequestDelete(type=...)`; the cases run once per type through the editor hook (med and lab hooks).
- `androidTest/.../storage/ClinicalDeleteRestoreDbTest.kt` (23 methods x kinds `listOf("medication","lab")` = 46 cases): only `deleteCmd`/`restoreCmd` helpers (`:211-`, 6 references) are rewritten to build generic commands; every assertion is untouched. New kinds extend `kinds()` (46 becomes 23 x N).
- New: `UndoCoordinatorTest` (virtual time: 8 s expiry, restart once then drop, ambiguous replay uses the same operationUuid, stale-patient-revision retry, newer offer replaces older, `clear()` on lock, stale token no-op); `DeletableRegistryTest` (all types registered, tags and receipt kinds unique, golden fingerprints for MED/LAB).
D653 Static check `check_r6b.py`: no `DeleteMedicationCommand|DeleteLabInvestigationCommand|RestoreMedicationCommand|RestoreLabInvestigationCommand|DeletionKind|RequestDeleteMedication|RequestDeleteLab` identifier left in `app/src/main`; `AncViewModel` has no `DeletableType.` branch (`when (...type)` forbidden outside `DeletableRecords.kt` and `ui` string mapper); `RecordsRepository` has exactly one `deleteRecord` and one `restoreRecord`; `app/schemas` and `RecordsDatabase` version unchanged vs HEAD; 8000 appears once.

## 5. Risks and review requirements
R1 A hash or fingerprint format drift silently breaks replay of receipts written by the current build and the restore guard (INVALID_COMMAND/RECORD_CONFLICT) -> golden-string tests (D652) and the 46-case DB test.
R2 Deleting clinical rows is irreversible after the window: any adapter that reports the wrong owner, revision or hash could delete another patient's or a stale row -> the repository compares patient and revision generically once; adapter tests must include cross-patient and stale cases per kind (DB test does).
R3 Timer/lock leakage: an offer or pending restore command holds a clinical record in memory; it must die at expiry, second failure, replacement and lock (`clear()` is called from `clearFrozenCommands`; test in `UndoCoordinatorTest`).
R4 Attachments hold files on disk (D629): a naive adapter would orphan or lose bytes; do not register until the two-phase design is reviewed.
R5 Backups taken before the delete still contain the row, receipts store a fingerprint only (D613 limits stay documented in one place).
R6 Shared mutable UI (one dialog/bar for the whole app): a second delete while an offer is open finalises the first (documented, tested).
Review: every round touching `app/src` (level-3 per AGENTS.md) needs a frontier-tier review plus an independent test review (the tests author differs from the core author). Reviewers get the diff, this spec and `check_r6b.py` output; vendors never receive patient data. Real-database DB test must be run on the emulator for R6b-1 and for every new adapter.

## 6. Rounds (pipeline `run_pipeline.py --round <r>`; add each id to the `--round` choices, the BRIEFS tuple, and an `ALLOW` block like `r6a` at `run_pipeline.py:327`)
R6b-1 `r6b1` storage generalisation. tests lane: `check_r6b1.py`, `TEST_MANIFEST.json`, `ClinicalCommandsTest.kt`, `ClinicalDeleteRuleTest.kt`, new `DeletableRegistryTest.kt`, `androidTest/.../ClinicalDeleteRestoreDbTest.kt` (helpers only). core lane: `storage/ClinicalCommands.kt`, new `storage/DeletableRecords.kt`, new `storage/MedicationDeleteAdapter.kt` + `LabDeleteAdapter.kt`, `storage/RecordsRepository.kt`, `storage/ClinicalDeleteRule.kt`, `model/ClinicalModels.kt` (DeletableRecord marker). ui lane: none. Exit: all unit tests + 46-case DB test green, golden fingerprints equal, no state/VM change except compile shims.
R6b-2 `r6b2` state and coordinator. tests lane: `check_r6b2.py`, `AncDeleteUndoStateTest.kt`, new `UndoCoordinatorTest.kt`. core lane: `state/AncState.kt`, `state/AncViewModel.kt`, new `state/UndoCoordinator.kt`, new `state/EditorHooks.kt`, `storage/ClinicalCommands.kt` (remove D651 factories). ui lane: none (compile shim only if `ui/` references removed events; if so allow the exact files `ui/MedicationEditor.kt`, `ui/LabEditor.kt`, `ui/WorkspaceScreen.kt` for the rename only).
R6b-3 `r6b3` shared UI (design round, owner reviews on device). ui lane: `ui/Components.kt` or new `ui/DeleteUi.kt`, `ui/AncApp.kt`, `res/values/strings.xml`. tests lane: `check_ui_static_r6b3.py` (one dialog, one bar host, 48 dp via `minimumTouchTarget`, strings once, no per-section `AlertDialog` for delete) and a pure `DeletableTypeStringsTest`. core lane: none.
R6b-4 `r6b4` wire medication and lab to the shared UI (replaces any per-screen delete wiring). ui lane: `ui/MedicationEditor.kt`, `ui/LabEditor.kt`, `ui/WorkspaceScreen.kt`. tests: static check that rows use `DeleteIconButton`.
R6b-5a/b/c `r6b5a` ultrasound, `r6b5b` previous pregnancy, `r6b5c` visit: each = one adapter file + registry entry + enum values + editor hook + `kinds()` entry in the DB test + one row of `DeleteIconButton`. core allow-list: the new adapter file, `DeletableRecords.kt`, `ClinicalCommands.kt` (enum values only), `EditorHooks.kt`; ui allow-list: the one section screen. Zero changes to repository, coordinator or reducer (static check asserts this by diffing those files).
R6b-6 `r6b6` attachments with the two-phase adapter (D629), separate spec addendum and review before start. Delivery plan joins as a 5x round once its record exists.

## Five most important decisions (summary)
1. D621/D622: one `DeletableRecordAdapter` per kind plus a single registry; adding a kind touches only its adapter, one list entry, one enum value.
2. D623/D624: generic `DeleteRecordCommand`/`RestoreRecordCommand` and exactly one `deleteRecord`/`restoreRecord` in the repository; fingerprint and receipt strings stay byte-identical, no Room schema or version change.
3. D626: `UndoCoordinator` owns timer, restart-once, ambiguous replay, stale-revision retry, replacement and lock clear; the ViewModel only delegates.
4. D625: generic `PendingDeletion/UndoOffer/RequestDelete` keyed by `DeletableType`; editor-specific closing and draft rebase move behind `EditorHook`.
5. D640-D643: one `DeleteConfirmDialog`, one app-level `UndoBarHost`, one 48 dp `DeleteIconButton`, strings defined once.

    val baseLabRevision: Long?,
    val original: LabDraftValues,

    val original: MedicationDraftValues,
    val values: MedicationDraftValues,
    val errors: Set<ClinicalValidationError> = emptySet(),
) {
    val isDirty: Boolean get() = values != original
}

data class AncState(
    val patients: List<DemoPatient>,
    val vaultState: VaultState = VaultState.Locked,
    val route: AncRoute = AncRoute.PatientList,
    val searchQuery: String = "",
    val draft: VisitDraft? = null,
    val patientDraft: PatientDraft? = null,
    val historiesDraft: HistoriesDraft? = null,

    val statusDraft: PatientStatusDraft? = null,

    val labDraft: LabDraft? = null,
    val medicationDraft: MedicationDraft? = null,
        val patientId: String,

    ) : AncEvent
    data class StartLabEditor(
        val patientId: String,
        val labId: String?,
        val newLabId: String,
        val editorSessionId: String,
        val defaultDate: String = "",
        val defaultLabName: String = "",
    ) : AncEvent
    data class StartMedicationEditor(
        val patientId: String,
        val medicationId: String?,
        val newMedicationId: String,
        val editorSessionId: String,
        val defaultStartDate: String = "",
    ) : AncEvent
    data class DatingDraftChanged(val field: DatingDraftField, val value: String) : AncEvent
    data class UltrasoundDraftChanged(val field: UltrasoundDraftField, val value: String) : AncEvent
    data class LabDraftChanged(val field: LabDraftField, val value: String) : AncEvent
    data class LabAbnormalChanged(val isAbnormal: Boolean) : AncEvent

    private fun startLabEditor(state: AncState, event: AncEvent.StartLabEditor): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing() || state.hasDirtyDraft) return state
        val patient = state.patient(event.patientId)?.takeIf { it.status != "archived" } ?: return state
        val lab = event.labId?.let { id -> patient.labInvestigations.firstOrNull { it.id == id } }
        if (event.labId != null && lab == null) return state
        val values = lab?.toDraftValues() ?: LabDraftValues(
            date = event.defaultDate,
            labName = event.defaultLabName,
        )
        val labId = lab?.id ?: event.newLabId
        return state.clearDrafts().copy(
            route = AncRoute.LabEditor(patient.id, labId, isNew = lab == null),
            labDraft = LabDraft(
                editorSessionId = event.editorSessionId,
                patientId = patient.id,
                labId = labId,
                basePatientRevision = patient.revision,
                baseLabRevision = lab?.revision,
                original = values,
                values = values,
            ),
            savedNotice = false,
            notice = null,
        )
    }

    private fun startMedicationEditor(state: AncState, event: AncEvent.StartMedicationEditor): AncState {
            it.displayName.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) ||

                (it.bloodGroupText != null && it.bloodGroupText.contains(query, ignoreCase = true))
        }
    }

    val hasDirtyDraft: Boolean
        get() = draft?.isDirty == true ||

            historiesDraft?.isDirty == true ||
            pregnancyDraft?.isDirty == true ||
            statusDraft?.isDirty == true ||
            datingDraft?.isDirty == true ||
            ultrasoundDraft?.isDirty == true ||
            labDraft?.isDirty == true ||
            medicationDraft?.isDirty == true
}

sealed interface AncEvent {
    data class SearchChanged(val query: String) : AncEvent
    private fun updateLabDraft(state: AncState, event: AncEvent.LabDraftChanged): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing()) return state
        val draft = state.labDraft ?: return state
        val values = when (event.field) {
            LabDraftField.DATE -> draft.values.copy(date = event.value)
            LabDraftField.CATEGORY -> draft.values.copy(testCategory = event.value)
            LabDraftField.NAME -> draft.values.copy(testName = event.value)
            LabDraftField.RESULT -> draft.values.copy(result = event.value)
